requirement: Every business feature has one owning domain module
No direct Prisma in routes/controllers; no cross-module repositories/private services
Critical consistency effects remain in one DB transaction
organizationId comes from authenticated membership context
Critical mutations produce stable business audit events
Standard data/meta and error envelopes are preserved
Workflow transitions use explicit command endpoints
Breaking changes require /v2 or controlled compatibility migration
UUID PKs + human business numbers separated
Stock/journal/audit are append-only or reversal based
Transactions, constraints, locks/version fields protect inventory/approval races
Business modules access MinIO only through StorageService
Queues only for non-critical side effects/integrations
Strong hashing, MFA baseline, session revocation, rate limiting
Install → quality → tests → security → DB validation → build → container checks → deploy → smoke
CRUD alone is not done; permissions, tenant, validation, state, audit, transactions, tests, docs, errors, migrations/indexes, logging required
